subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: Should configured OpenAI-compatible memory embeddings inherit `models.providers.<id>.request.allowPrivateNetwork` as their SSRF trust contract, including explicit `false` disabling exact-host private trust?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and proven, but it deliberately decides where the private-network trust boundary lives and whether explicit provider denial should override current exact-host compatibility.

options.title: Accept Provider Policy
options.body: Approve provider request policy as the canonical memory embedding trust source and merge after normal exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Require Memory-Specific Policy
options.body: Ask for a memory-owned trust surface instead of inheriting provider request policy.

options.title: Preserve Exact-Host on False
options.body: Require explicit false to block broad private-network access while keeping exact configured hostname trust.

recommendation.title: Accept Provider Policy
recommendation.body: Approve provider request policy as the canonical memory embedding trust source and merge after normal exact-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged provider bridge and core move history make this the strongest routing candidate for the owner-boundary decision.
